title: Assault on SC lawyer: Supreme Court orders police to frame attempt to murder charge against accused
description: The Supreme Court on Thursday directed the Delhi Police to invoke the offences of attempt to murder and voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons against persons accused of attacking Advocate Pankaj Sharma at his Delhi residence. [Pankaj Sharma v.
